status.sentence: Burning has been above the 90th percentile for this time of year for at least 3 consecutive days.

peaks.sentence: Peak season: Aug, Sep, Jul (highest median burning). Most active year: 2011.

current_vs_median.sentence: So far this Nov (days 1–14): 3.4× the usual level — 2nd highest of 24 years.

counts.note: Raw hotspot counts are per sensor and are never added together; the harmonized count is burning cell-days (~2.2 km cells with a detection).

sensor_diff.sentence: On days both sensors observed, VIIRS also saw 41% of MODIS burning cells, and saw 6,782 cells MODIS missed — which is why raw counts can't simply be added.

critical_windows.sentence: Burning here is too sparse to define a critical window.

provenance_legend.observed: Both MODIS and VIIRS observed the day; value = union of burning cells.
provenance_legend.estimated: Only one sensor observed; value bridged with the calibration factor (band = 90% CI).
provenance_legend.mixed: Month contains both observed and estimated days.
provenance_legend.cached: Precomputed result shown because the live API did not respond.
